label: Spout drips while closed
detail: Steady drip with the handle off: the seat washer no longer seals.

label: Cracked O-ring at handle base
detail: The seal ring under the handle is cracked, so water escapes around the stem.

label: Water tracking down the body
detail: Seepage runs down both sides of the valve body and leaves mineral scale.

label: Shutoff valves found
detail: Both supply valves are reachable, so you can do this without shutting off the whole house.
